role.altitude: The bellhop keeps greeting, finding and escorting guests and handling their bags and complaints in person; walking every public area to page a guest and copying guest details onto paper claim forms shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A bellhop who reaches most guests with one message and spends the saved walking time at the door.

tasks.short: Take the paging request, look up the guest and check the message, phone or message the guest, page guests in hotel lobbies, dining rooms or other areas, and pass on the message or escort them.

steps.what: Bellhop takes the paging request and the guest's name from the front desk or a visitor
Bellhop looks up the guest in the hotel system and checks the room, contact and message text
Bellhop phones the guest's room, or messages the guest's phone if they opted in
Bellhop pages guests in hotel lobbies, dining rooms and other areas by walking and calling the name
Bellhop passes on the message or escorts the guest to the visitor or taxi

approvals.approved_version: The paging message text and the guest's room or phone number as checked by the bellhop in s2; a different guest or text needs a new check before sending.

tasks.design: Guests who opt in at check-in get paging messages on their phone through the hotel's guest messaging tool, which reaches them in the restaurant or the garden as well as in the room. The bellhop checks the guest and the short text and sends it, and walks the public areas only when the guest has not opted in or does not reply within a few minutes. Passing on the message and escorting stay personal. The phone number is used only for messages the guest agreed to.
tasks.previous_blocker: A room call only reached guests in their room, so the rest meant walking every area.
tasks.enabler_now: Guest messaging tools linked to the hotel system.
tasks.still_hard: Guests who keep their phone off during dinner.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising a guest by sight from a short description.
tasks.altitude: Less walking; finding and escorting stay.

reach.learn: Whether visitors wait less for guests.

evidence.claim: Hotel guest messaging tools reach guests on messaging apps and website chat and integrate with hotel systems.

assumptions: Boundary: paging guests; giving directions and information (task 2315) is a sibling task.
Input contract for s3 and s4: about half of guests opt in to messaging at check-in, recorded by the front desk; about 40% of pagings end with a message reply; s4 is priced at that share.
Sending a message takes about as long as a room call, so s3 keeps its time; taking the request, checking and escorting keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of guests who opt in to messaging.
research_questions: Is time to find a guest shorter?

incremental.description: Bellhop keeps paging message texts current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few guests opted in; high: half the guests opted in and replying.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Take the guest's report and inspect the bag, photograph the damage, complete baggage insurance forms, check the final form with the guest, and submit it to the duty manager and insurer.

steps.what: Bellhop takes the guest's report of lost or damaged baggage and inspects the bag
Bellhop completes the baggage insurance form: guest and stay details, item description, value and circumstances
Bellhop checks the final form with the guest and records the guest's signature
Bellhop submits the signed form with photos to the duty manager and the insurer

approvals.approved_version: The form as checked with the guest and signed in s4, with the photos attached there; any change needs a new check and signature before submitting.

tasks.design: The baggage claim form is a screen in the hotel system that fills guest, room and stay details from the booking and takes the photos straight from the tablet, instead of a paper form filled by hand and photos printed. The bellhop types the item description, value and what happened. Inspecting the bag, checking with the guest and the signature stay personal. The signed form goes to the duty manager and the insurer from the system in one step instead of being scanned and mailed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper forms, printed photos and scans by mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Hotel system forms pre-filled from the booking.
tasks.still_hard: Guests who disagree about how the damage happened.
tasks.human_edge: Calming an upset guest while writing down the facts.
tasks.altitude: Less copying and scanning; the guest conversation stays.

reach.learn: Whether claims are complete the first time.

evidence.claim: Hotel systems can pre-fill forms with guest and stay details from the booking.

assumptions: Boundary: baggage claim forms; charge slips and records (task 2325) are a sibling task.
Input contract for s3: guest, room and stay details from the booking in the hotel system, about a third of the form's fields.
Inspecting, photographing and checking with the guest keep their full time.

incremental.description: Bellhop reports form fields the insurer asks for that are missing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: complex claims needing long descriptions; high: simple claims with booking details pre-filled.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
